slides.name: The Bullet — Classic
slides.headline: The simple, battery-powered classic. *A gentle, affordable first step.*
One button. *No charging.*
slides.body: It runs on a single AA-type “tiger” battery: put one in, switch on, explore gently. Light, pocket-sized and beginner-friendly. Keep a spare battery handy.

slides.headline: Body-safe silicone tip, *ABS body.*
slides.body: Phthalate-free, according to the manufacturer. Wipe it clean, use water-based lubricant only, and take the battery out for storage to protect the motor.
slides.note: Details from the product page on intimova.ng.

slides.headline: Plain, unbranded packaging. *Always.*
slides.lead: Nationwide delivery from ₦6,000. Faulty or wrong? Tell us within 2 days of delivery and we replace it free.
